commit_message: Use host evidence for native validation readiness
pr_body: Require NativeAgentRuntime readiness to be proven by Agent Host-recorded successful mutations rather than generic model-loop exchange strings. Planned source work now requires a successful managed workspace write event, planned project work requires a successful governed MCP mutation event, and planned asset work requires managed acquisition or governed mutation evidence. Runtime progress/read-only exchanges cannot fabricate implementation completion. Regression tests cover exchange-only false positives and host-recorded read-only versus mutating MCP actions. This correction also restores rustfmt-compatible test imports. The existing NotApplicable source-validation wording fix remains. Logic-only change; Visual Validation is not required.
